IconSurface.usage: Governed icon + background composition. A single tone controls icon color and same-family background; the default neutral tone renders the icon itself with neutral primary color.icon.primary on a neutral subtle background. background=visible paints the governed background, while background=hidden keeps the alignment slot without painting a surface but still keeps the icon default at neutral primary. Use tone=tertiary only for explicit low-emphasis icon surfaces. Use styleVariant=fill for active, selected, or emphasized icon actions while keeping the same tone pairing. Shortcut or quick-action entry buttons that need a visible icon background should render their glyph through IconSurface instead of a page-local View + AppIcon shell.
forbidden: Do not add border styles to icon backgrounds
Do not pass separate icon and background colors
Do not use brand tone for ordinary neutral feature, form, card, or list icons
Do not use for menu disclosure chevrons; use pure AppIcon at 16px tertiary

BottomSheet.usage: Global bottom sheet system. Use presets for every page-triggered mobile sheet. Opening or stacking a sheet dismisses the active keyboard and releases input focus before presentation. Header and fixed footer actions keep 16px horizontal inset; card-mode content defaults to 12px, while plain/form content opts into 16px. List-only selection sheets can request sheetSurface=panel so the sheet uses the white panel surface instead of the page canvas; card/detail sheets keep the canvas default. Selection sheets default to fill sizing so long option lists use the governed scroll container. Header and content keep full text opacity while translating through the shared entrance progress, preserving readable sheet content after presentation. Fixed footer action areas start hidden below the sheet, follow the sheet entrance and dismissal, and never remain visible after content exits. Footer action areas do not render a top divider; short content uses a non-scroll container at natural content height with a governed reading gap before fixed actions, measured footer avoidance protects actions, backdrop tap and pan-down close are mandatory, and only over-height content becomes scrollable. Every page-level bottom sheet must be opened through useBottomSheet with bottomSheetPresets.selection/detail/actionMenu or a registered business sheet wrapper exported from design-public-assets.
forbidden: Do not call bottomSheet.show or bottomSheet.push with ad hoc options; use bottomSheetPresets
Do not add page-local Keyboard.dismiss calls before bottomSheet.show or bottomSheet.push; the shared provider owns keyboard dismissal
Do not import or render BottomSheetModal outside src/components/BottomSheet.tsx
Do not create page-local sheet containers
Do not create page-local scrims, handles, SafeArea bottom shells, or absolute bottom modal containers
Do not override BottomSheet footer background or add page-local footer dividers
Do not add fixed content bottom insets to compensate for footer actions
Do not wrap short sheet content in page-local vertical scroll containers to force scrolling
Do not animate content and fixed footer on separate entrance or dismissal timelines
Do not render fixed footer action areas visible or interactive before the shared sheet entrance progress completes or after dismissal begins
Do not import useBottomSheet or bottomSheetPresets in pages from runtime-private component paths; use src/design-public-assets/components.
Do not use React Native Modal to simulate a bottom sheet.
